verdict.outcome_rationale: This was a genuine agent-fault failure — the verifier's FAIL is correct (TN). The verifier parsed `/workspace/answer.txt` and compared it to ground truth, reporting INCORRECT because the answer listed Port Hedland in addition to Melbourne and Sydney [1][2]. The task asked for cities where NEXTDC added additional built capacity during calendar year 2023, ordered by MW added smallest-first [3], and the correct ordered answer is only Melbourne (2 Digital Realty data centers, 3 MW added) and Sydney (4 data centers, 4 MW added) [4]. The NEXTDC half-year results distinguish Sydney and Melbourne, where built capacity was explicitly "added", from Port Hedland, which "opened to customers with 0.5MW of built capacity" [5]; the reference solution applies that same reading by counting only lines containing "added" and excluding mere openings [6]. The agent read that development-activity passage in full [7] but still concluded Port Hedland belonged in the city set [8], then wrote `Port Hedland - 0`, `Melbourne - 2`, and `Sydney - 4` to answer.txt [9] and declared the task complete [10]. Melbourne and Sydney facility counts were correct, but the spurious Port Hedland entry means the agent did not truly solve the task.
